title: Northloop Payments Seller Terms: One Payments Account per Seller
content:
**Clause.** A seller holds at most one Northloop Payments account; every selling plan, FBN enrollment and order of the seller settles into it. A closed account does not count.

## The clause in its parts

| Point | Rule |
|---|---|
| How many payments accounts a seller may hold | at most 1 Northloop Payments account |
| What settles into it | every selling plan, every FBN enrollment and every order of that seller |
| Closed accounts | a closed payments account does not count toward the limit of 1 |

## Points of judgement

- *A seller has a store plan and an FBN enrollment.* Both settle into the one Northloop Payments account the seller holds; neither opens a second account.
- *A seller's earlier payments account is closed.* The closed account does not count, so the limit of 1 is measured on the seller's accounts that are not closed.
